test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a round table facing the centre. Sahil is the immediate neighbor of both Palak and Ruchi. Tanay is sitting second to the left of Palak. Urmi is sitting third to the right of Ruchi. Qasim is the immediate neighbor of both Ruchi and Tanay. Who is the immediate neighbor of both Urmi and Qasim?
solution:
Given: Six students are seated around a circular table, facing the center.

1) Tanay is seated second to the left of Palak.

2) Palak and Ruchi both have Sahil as their immediate neighbor. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2307fbbd02d2ce7df822441773218f07c823a19136bd937c7f1dd4e7b3601019.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e45b9ead7e00074048eb5a40206534b99012e9d2cd7a2321cde707e30b867db.png] 

3) Urmi is seated third to the right of Ruchi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c9070226114dca53c32904d7060d8870f8e3869857bf637757ecec3d8b47e30.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/335c16bc5f5f60ff9a15c3a7c7b57242cad7631ab4f00b82bbe97a5ff330d790.png] 

4) Both Ruchi and Tanay have Qasim as their immediate neighbor. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bf37ca05babce81276cd46ba4aa6ac14344f7dd305e3f0d7d4ddc241194068f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b3460a91bd83a2dd585715ebc251f3fd59209b0e789f119e3d67a0c83ea2ddc.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Tanay is the immediate neighbor of both Urmi and Qasim.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
